result:
Summary: ManuRAG is a novel multi-modal Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) framework designed for manufacturing question answering (MQA). It integrates and analyzes complex multi-modal data, such as text, images, formulas, and tables, which conventional RAG methods often struggle with. ManuRAG1 processes both textual and visual data by embedding them into respective vector databases and uses a Multi-modal Large Language Model (MLLM) for answer generation. ManuRAG3 extends ManuRAG1 by prioritizing the retrieval of visual data linked within the retrieved text chunks. ManuRAG2 operates exclusively on textual data, representing a high-quality text-only RAG baseline. The system addresses the inherent multi-modality of manufacturing documents, requiring seamless integration of diverse data types to provide accurate, contextually relevant answers.
